title: MDR SPUTNIK - Einfach die beste Musik - Deine Lieblingsmusik

lines.l: Daylight makes me feel like Dracula
In the end I hope it's you and me
In the darkness I would never leave
You don't want to never see me in the light of day
I'm on the verge of caving it
I run back to a dark
My friends are saying, shut up Jenny, just get in the car
I just wanna be right where you are
In the end, I hope it's you and me
In the darkness, I would never leave
The toughest moment coming from afar
Come pull up in my spot
I got my knee to the sky
Love the blow sinking in my teeth
Do you think about what it might mean?
Cause I dream about you in my sleep
Could you ever love someone like me?
In the end I hope it's you and me
In the darkness I would never leave
We both saw this moment coming from afar
So run from the sunlight, Dracula
